Sara — great questions. TL;DR: flexible company hop-on/hop-off is fine; hosts will rotate in a staggered handoff to keep continuity. Details below.

Plan (short):
- Main room (all-hands) 6:00–6:10pm PT: 10m welcome + agenda + quick infra note.
- Breakouts (6:10–7:30pm PT): rolling 20–25m rotations. Teams can drop back to main room between rounds.
- Host rotation: we have 3 hosts staggered every 25 minutes so someone is always in each breakout for overlap. No single host will be pulled across more than two simultaneous breakouts.
- If a single company needs a longer sync, we schedule a 15m follow-up with a Solutions Engineer (off-bridge).

Attachments: cohort_bridge_runbook_v2.pdf (runbook) and evening-standby-rotation.ics (calendar slots) — attaching now.

Ask for you: if you expect >4 attendees, reply with a quick headcount so we can reserve a dedicated breakout slot.

See you tonight — link is the same.
